scope: Reuse exact thermodynamic-state evaluations in the variable-composition EOS. Fixed three entries per requested derivative channel per thread; table identity survives address reuse. No interpolation, source mask, physical model or numerical tolerance changes.
timing_qualification: One simultaneous timing pair; scheduling and cache variation included.
additional_regressions: Repeated thermal/force/heat requests preserve requested derivatives
Invalid T, rho and abundance basis remain rejected after a supported query
Replacement EOS at the same address uses its own source material and masks
selection_note: Actual continuation preserves all startup physical history fields exactly.
